scenario.description: A neurology clinic director must assign the clinic's one urgent consultation opening this week among three referrals and finalize the follow-up arrangements for the patients who will not receive that opening, with input from a neurologist, a referral coordinator, and an accessibility coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The neurology clinic has one urgent consultation opening this week, and referrals for Patient A, Patient B, and Patient C are awaiting triage.
shared_context.S2: Marisol makes the final referral-priority and follow-up decisions.
shared_context.S3: All three referrals currently have enough basic information for an administrative triage review.
shared_context.S4: The clinic's routine triage meeting follows a round-robin: the neurologist, referral coordinator, and accessibility coordinator each report relevant updates before Marisol closes the agenda and assigns the opening.
shared_context.S5: The clinic's meeting protocol requires each update that is not already in the shared referral system to be entered as a formal disclosure before it is used in the final plan; merely mentioning an update does not put it on the record.

PF1.text: Dr. Chen reviewed Patient A's outside symptom summary and found repeated episodes of one-sided weakness lasting about 20 minutes; Chen recommends a neurology evaluation within 48 hours and a 60-minute new-patient consultation, but the clinical review has not yet been entered into the referral queue.

PF2.text: Patient B already has a confirmed neurology appointment at Lakeside Medical Center this Friday at 14:00, so the clinic should not consume its urgent opening for B and should record Lakeside as the follow-up site.

PF3.text: Patient C uses American Sign Language and requires a certified ASL interpreter for a 90-minute neurology visit; the interpreter request must be submitted by Wednesday at 12:00 to support the next available routine appointment. The settlement must record the interpreter request as logged by setting patient_c_asl_interpreter_request_logged to true.

interaction_config.settle_trigger: Marisol may settle after the neurologist, referral coordinator, and accessibility coordinator have each reported and all relevant updates are available.

acceptance_conditions: Patient A must receive the urgent consultation opening.
The consultation for Patient A must be scheduled within 48 hours and must be 60 minutes.
Patient B's follow-up must be recorded at Lakeside Medical Center on Friday at 14:00.
Patient C's visit must be planned for 90 minutes.
Patient C's ASL interpreter request deadline must be recorded as Wednesday at 12:00.
The ASL interpreter request for Patient C must be logged by Wednesday at 12:00.
The clinical finding supporting Patient A's urgent priority must be cited.

content_checks.C5: decisions['patient_b_follow_up_site'] == 'Lakeside Medical Center' and (decisions['patient_b_follow_up_time'] == 'Friday at 14:00' or decisions['patient_b_follow_up_time'] == 'Friday 14:00' or decisions['patient_b_follow_up_time'] == '14:00 Friday' or decisions['patient_b_follow_up_time'] == 'Friday 2:00 PM')

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The documented episodes change Patient A from an undifferentiated referral to the patient requiring evaluation within 48 hours and a consultation lasting exactly 60 minutes.
The confirmed Lakeside appointment changes Patient B's follow-up site to Lakeside Medical Center and fixes the follow-up time at Friday at 14:00.

Patient C's accessibility requirements change the planned visit duration to exactly 90 minutes, fix the interpreter-request deadline at Wednesday at 12:00, and require the settlement to set patient_c_asl_interpreter_request_logged to true.
